cohort: The study included 200 women (100 in each group) undergoing lower segment cesarean section (LSCS).
finding: Heat-stable carbetocin was associated with significantly less intraoperative blood loss and better uterine contractility compared to oxytocin, without significant variation in patient hemodynamic parameters.
mod_finding: Carbetocin, when used during lower segment cesarean section (LSCS), proved very effective in preventing atonic postpartum hemorrhage.
